reference_sql:
SELECT product_id,
       unit_cost_eur * 1.25 AS list_price_eur,
       unit_cost_eur * 1.25 * 0.90 AS sale_price_eur,
       unit_cost_eur * 1.25 * 0.90 - unit_cost_eur AS profit_eur
FROM products

solver.query: SELECT product_id, list_price_eur, list_price_eur - list_price_eur * 0.10 AS sale_price_eur, list_price_eur - list_price_eur * 0.10 - unit_cost_eur AS profit_eur FROM (SELECT product_id, unit_cost_eur, unit_cost_eur + unit_cost_eur * 0.25 AS list_price_eur FROM products) AS p
